name.value: Best Western Plus Regency Inn & Conference Centre

description.value: The Best Western Plus Regency Inn & Conference Centre bills itself as Abbotsford's largest full-service hotel, with a conference centre, two indoor pools, a fitness centre, and an onsite restaurant (Ricky's Country Restaurant). The property specializes in group and corporate travel and has won the Best Western Director's Award. Touring cyclists will find it a comfortable, amenity-rich base for exploring the Fraser Valley.

raw_osm.name: Best Western Plus Regency Inn & Conference Centre

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at bwregency.bc.ca loaded successfully and is the primary evidence source. The site consistently identifies this property as being in Abbotsford (not Chilliwack as the OSM community field states), and confirms the street address and phone number. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content; Wi-Fi is confirmed by both OSM (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no) and the website ('Free Wireless Internet Access'); Ricky's Country Restaurant is listed in the site navigation as an onsite amenity, confirming onsite evening dining.
concerns: OSM community field is tagged as 'Chilliwack' but the website consistently identifies the property as being in Abbotsford — the address and postal code confirm Abbotsford.

The website's primary booking phone number is 1-800-771-3077, which differs from the OSM-listed 604-853-3111; the latter appears on staff contact pages and is likely the direct line, so both may be valid but the discrepancy is noted.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational full-service hotel with an active website and confirmed contact details; clearly open and publicly accessible to touring cyclists.

Nearby evening food.detail: Ricky's Country Restaurant is listed as an onsite amenity in the site navigation
